intro: End long days your way with TuneIn Sink into plush seats, recline at the touch of a button, ease back stress, and charge your phone while you relax. Your comfort, your control, without ever leaving the couch.

features.title: Recline your way, every day
features.text: Independently adjust recline, headrest, and lumbar settings, while the chaise gives you extra space to stretch and sink into comfort.

features.title: Right-hand chaise comfort
features.text: Perfect for layouts where you want the chaise on the right, this variant adapts seamlessly to your living space without compromising comfort.

features.title: Console with smart storage
features.text: Keep essentials like remotes and chargers within arm’s reach, thanks to the convenient built-in storage console.

features.title: Charge without moving a muscle
features.text: Built-in USB-A and Type-C ports keep your devices powered, so you never interrupt your comfort just to hunt for a charging point.

features.title: Style that feels like home
features.text: Dual-tone mushroom fabric and peanut leatherette combine contemporary aesthetics with everyday coziness.

features.title: Upholstery built to last
features.text: Durable, easy-to-clean fabric keeps the recliner looking fresh while offering long-term comfort.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Tunein Motorised 2-Seater Fabric Recliner With Console And Right Hand Chaise
